description: Defines various notification argument structures related to input events in Android, such as device changes, key events, motion events, sensor events, switch events, device resets, pointer capture changes, and vibrator states. Also includes a variant type for all these notifications and a toString function.

classes.name: NotifyInputDevicesChangedArgs
classes.description: Describes a change in connected input devices.

classes.name: NotifyMotionArgs
classes.description: Describes a motion event, including touch and mouse events.

classes.name: NotifyDeviceResetArgs
classes.description: Describes a device reset event (added, reconfigured, or removed).

classes.name: NotifyPointerCaptureChangedArgs
classes.description: Describes a change in Pointer Capture state.
